description: For X drawn from LogGamma(a,b), log(X) has a Gamma distribution with shape a and scale b (not rate). Thus X > 1; the mean and variance of log(X) are a*b and a*b^2.
title: The exponential of a gamma-distributed variable
name: LogGamma

args.name: a
args.description: Shape parameter of the distribution of log(X)

args.name: b
args.description: Scale parameter of the distribution of log(X)
